actions.text: A hollow rasp echoes from the shadows as the crypt ghoul turns toward you.
The ghoul lunges with blackened claws, swiping at your throat!

properties.description: an open cobbled courtyard surrounded by ancient stone walls.
a grand hall with high ceilings and banners hanging from the walls.
a secured chamber stocked with weapons and sturdy racks.
an elevated walkway overlooking the perimeter.
a warm kitchen with a large hearth and prep tables.
a cool pantry lined with shelves and provisions.
a fortified station where the keep guards keep watch.
the circular base of the watchtower with winding stairs.
a secluded overgrown garden filled with wild herbs.
a quiet sanctuary lined with towering bookshelves.
a hidden stone vault concealed behind the bookshelves.
a dark cell with heavy damp walls and iron shackles.
